limitations: Only the instrumented bank callback/API paths are counted.
Numeric event return IDs do not prove audible voices; successful event IDs were not retained.
Pool peaks are sampled; occupancy does not measure fragmentation or prove no GetBlock/CreatePool failure.
Loading completion and audible-loss timestamps were not explicitly marked.
Counts and peaks are observed at the installed native paths; gauge fields are last-update snapshots.
An unexercised attachment path has no measured demand; zero attempts is not a saturated list.
Selected reuse does not prove successful reinsertion or audible playback.
Native counters are independent snapshots; small in-flight imbalances are possible.
Owner/event aggregate rows are emitted on changes about every5s and may trail final status.
Owner addresses can be reused; rows aggregate lifetimes and are not vehicle identities.
Projected accepted peak is pre-insertion count+1; observed peak reads the native field.
Admitted events/lookup hits do not establish downstream voice/media/mixer success.
Input names cover only the two instrumented string wrappers, with bounded details.
